headline.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS: the next generation of expressive AI speech
headline.summary: Gemini has launched its 3.1 Flash TTS, a new generation of AI speech technology designed to deliver more expressive and natural-sounding voice outputs. This update aims to enhance user experience in applications requiring advanced text-to-speech capabilities.

articles.title: DeepL, known for text translation, now wants to translate your voice
articles.summary: DeepL has announced plans to expand its translation services to include voice translation, aiming for real-time functionality in platforms such as Zoom and Microsoft Teams. The company believes its technology can enhance communication by providing seamless voice translation during meetings.

articles.title: Accelerating the cyber defense ecosystem that protects us all
articles.summary: OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber initiative has partnered with leading security firms and enterprises to enhance global cyber defense using the GPT-5.4-Cyber model. The initiative includes $10 million in API grants aimed at accelerating the development of cybersecurity solutions.

articles.title: AI-Assisted Peer Review at Scale: The AAAI-26 AI Review Pilot
articles.summary: The AAAI-26 conference has initiated a large-scale pilot program for AI-assisted peer review to address challenges in maintaining review quality amid rising submission volumes. This deployment aims to evaluate the effectiveness of AI in generating technically sound reviews in a real-world conference setting.

articles.title: 4th Workshop on Maritime Computer Vision (MaCVi): Challenge Overview
articles.summary: The 4th Workshop on Maritime Computer Vision (MaCVi), part of CVPR 2026, introduces five benchmark challenges focused on predictive accuracy and real-time feasibility. The report outlines the challenge setup, evaluation protocols, datasets, and presents quantitative and qualitative analyses of emerging trends in methods.

articles.title: L2D-Clinical: Learning to Defer for Adaptive Model Selection in Clinical Text Classification
articles.summary: The L2D-Clinical framework introduces a method for adaptive model selection in clinical text classification, determining when a BERT classifier should defer to a general-purpose large language model based on uncertainty signals and text characteristics. This approach aims to improve classification accuracy by leveraging the strengths of both specialized and general models.

articles.title: A 3D SAM-Based Progressive Prompting Framework for Multi-Task Segmentation of Radiotherapy-induced Normal Tissue Injuries in Limited-Data Settings
articles.summary: A new study presents a 3D SAM-based progressive prompting framework designed for the multi-task segmentation of radiotherapy-induced normal tissue injuries, addressing challenges posed by limited data and variability in lesion characteristics. The framework aims to improve the accuracy of injury region segmentation from medical images, which is crucial for effective disease assessment and treatment planning.

articles.title: DF3DV-1K: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Distractor-Free Novel View Synthesis
articles.summary: The DF3DV-1K dataset has been introduced to support the development of distractor-free novel view synthesis by providing a large-scale collection of clean and cluttered images across various scenes. This dataset aims to facilitate comprehensive benchmarking and advance research in photorealistic radiance fields.

articles.title: Monthly Diffusion v0.9: A Latent Diffusion Model for the First AI-MIP
articles.summary: Monthly Diffusion v0.9 is a climate emulator that utilizes a Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder architecture to model low-frequency atmospheric variability through latent diffusion at a 1.5-degree grid spacing. This version is designed for monthly mean timesteps and operates effectively in data-sparse conditions with modest computational requirements.

articles.title: Beyond Voxel 3D Editing: Learning from 3D Masks and Self-Constructed Data
articles.summary: The article discusses advancements in 3D editing techniques that focus on maintaining semantic consistency and local invariance during modifications. It highlights the limitations of current methods, such as multi-view editing and voxel-based approaches, and proposes learning from 3D masks and self-constructed data to improve the editing process.

articles.title: FRAGATA: Semantic Retrieval of HPC Support Tickets via Hybrid RAG over 20 Years of Request Tracker History
articles.summary: The paper introduces FRAGATA, a hybrid retrieval system designed to improve access to over 20 years of technical support tickets at the Galician Supercomputing Center, addressing limitations in the existing Request Tracker search engine. By utilizing semantic retrieval techniques, FRAGATA aims to enhance knowledge reuse among support staff and streamline incident resolution processes.

articles.title: A Dynamic-Growing Fuzzy-Neuro Controller, Application to a 3PSP Parallel Robot
articles.summary: The article presents a Dynamic Growing Fuzzy Neural Controller (DGFNC) that integrates fuzzy systems and neural networks to enhance decision-making capabilities. This controller is specifically applied to the position control of a 3PSP parallel robot, with a focus on its dynamic growing mechanism.
